purpose: Measure raw attack per piece for the current best 200k review profile against corrected legacy in an FT7-style set. Diagnostic only; do not use APP to score or promote strategy.
candidate: BotConfig::review_h9_h12() = H1 + H2 + H6C + H9 + H12
legacy: BotConfig::legacy() with zero-gravity softdrop, H12 on, H1/H2/H6C/H9 off, H13 off

telemetry.raw_attack: sum of tetrio::attack packets before self-cancellation
telemetry.cancelled: raw attack consumed by own pending garbage

caveat: The arena is the same zero-gravity turn-based S2 authority used by lineage experiments, not an official simultaneous TETR.IO server simulation. APP is therefore useful diagnostic context, not a direct reproduction of live TL stats.
interpretation: Exploratory only. The current best profile produced slightly higher raw APP and materially higher sent APP than corrected legacy, but lost the single FT7 set 5-7. This does not override the larger paired KO lineage evidence. It demonstrates that the current profile is not merely low-attack survival play, while also illustrating that APP is not equivalent to KO outcome.
